corrections.before: Control system that prevents a compressor from operating in the surge region by recycling gas or adjusting speed
corrections.after: Control that maintains margin from compressor surge, commonly by recycling gas; its effectiveness depends on the map, sensors, valve dynamics and implemented logic.

corrections.before: A measure of petroleum liquid density relative to water (°API)
corrections.after: Petroleum-liquid density scale: 141.5/SG(60/60 °F) − 131.5. The reference temperatures are part of the definition.

corrections.before: Computing exact derivatives of a function by applying the chain rule algorithmically to each elementary operation
corrections.after: Chain-rule differentiation of implemented elementary operations, accurate to floating-point arithmetic for the differentiable executed path; branches and numerical solvers need appropriate derivative treatment.

corrections.before: Bottomhole pressure — reservoir pressure at the wellbore face
corrections.after: Bottomhole pressure at a stated well datum; flowing BHP differs from average reservoir pressure and from shut-in pressure.

corrections.before: Barrels of oil equivalent — standardized energy unit for production
corrections.after: Barrel of oil equivalent; an energy-equivalent reporting quantity whose conversion factor and heating-value basis must be stated.

corrections.before: The pressure at which the first gas bubble forms from a liquid mixture
corrections.after: For a specified mixture and temperature, the pressure at which an infinitesimal vapor phase first coexists with the liquid; a bubble-point temperature can instead be defined at fixed pressure.

corrections.before: Verification that equipment can handle the required flow rates, pressures, and temperatures
corrections.after: Comparison of operating demands with explicitly configured equipment limits, subject to the rating basis, model applicability and completeness of the checked constraints.

corrections.before: Cricondenbar — the maximum pressure on the phase envelope
corrections.after: Cricondenbar: maximum pressure of vapor–liquid coexistence for a specified mixture; not necessarily the mixture critical pressure.

corrections.before: Cricondentherm — the maximum temperature on the phase envelope
corrections.after: Cricondentherm: maximum temperature of vapor–liquid coexistence for a specified mixture; not a standard or necessarily the critical temperature.

corrections.before: Unstable operating condition where flow reverses through the compressor
corrections.after: Low-flow system instability involving pressure and flow oscillations, potentially including flow reversal; the boundary depends on the compressor and connected system.

corrections.before: Distribution-free method producing prediction intervals with guaranteed coverage probability without model assumptions
corrections.after: Prediction-set calibration with finite-sample marginal coverage under the method's assumptions, commonly exchangeability; it does not guarantee conditional coverage or remain valid under arbitrary distribution shift.

corrections.before: Valve flow coefficient — relates flow rate to pressure drop across a valve
corrections.after: Valve flow coefficient based on US gallons per minute of water at about 60 °F producing a 1 psi pressure drop. Gas, cavitation and choked-flow calculations require the appropriate sizing relations.

corrections.before: Deep Operator Network — neural network architecture that learns mappings between function spaces for rapid PDE solution
corrections.after: Deep Operator Network: a learned mapping between function spaces, used as a surrogate for solution operators within a demonstrated training and validation domain.

corrections.before: A computational model that mirrors a physical system in real time
corrections.after: A computational representation connected to observations of a physical asset, with defined update, synchronization and validation procedures; connection alone does not establish accuracy.

corrections.before: Determination of phase equilibrium (vapor-liquid split) at given conditions
corrections.after: Equilibrium phase amounts and compositions at specified constraints, such as temperature/pressure or enthalpy/pressure; more than two phases may be present.

corrections.before: Honeywell UniSim Design (formerly AspenTech HYSYS) process simulator
corrections.after: Aspen HYSYS, an AspenTech process simulator. Honeywell UniSim Design is a separate product.

corrections.before: Joule-Thomson effect — temperature drop when gas expands through a valve
corrections.after: Cooling during approximately isenthalpic throttling when the Joule–Thomson coefficient is positive. Throttling can instead heat a fluid when that coefficient is negative.

corrections.before: Souders-Brown factor — used to size separator gas capacity
corrections.after: Here, the Souders–Brown separator capacity factor, with velocity units; distinguish it from the dimensionless phase-equilibrium ratio K_i = y_i/x_i.

corrections.before: UQ technique: randomly drop neurons during inference to estimate epistemic uncertainty from prediction variance
corrections.after: Approximate uncertainty estimation from repeated stochastic network evaluations with dropout; prediction spread needs calibration and is not automatically a reliable physical-error bound.

corrections.before: Simultaneous flow of gas, oil, and water in pipes
corrections.after: Simultaneous transport of two or more phases, for example gas–liquid, oil–water or gas–oil–water.

corrections.before: Net present value — discounted sum of future cash flows
corrections.after: Net present value: the sum of cash flows, including initial investment, discounted to a specified valuation date using a stated discount-rate convention.

corrections.before: Outflow Performance Relationship — pressure drop in the tubing and flowline
corrections.after: Outflow performance relationship: pressure required to transport a specified rate through tubing and downstream equipment for stated outlet and thermal conditions.

corrections.before: Productivity index — rate per unit pressure drawdown (bbl/d/psi)
corrections.after: Productivity index: production rate divided by pressure drawdown on a stated flow/pressure basis; the linear relation has an applicability range.

corrections.before: Compressor efficiency measure based on a polytropic (reversible) process path
corrections.after: For compression, the ratio of differential ideal pressure work to differential actual enthalpy rise along the compression path; real-gas evaluation requires thermodynamic properties and a defined method.

corrections.before: The ratio of actual throughput to maximum capacity of an equipment item
corrections.after: Dimensionless operating demand divided by the relevant declared limit; separate limits may apply to power, actual volume, gas load, liquid retention or other quantities.

corrections.before: Relationships for centrifugal machines: flow proportional to speed, head to speed squared, power to speed cubed
corrections.after: Approximate centrifugal-machine similarity relations: flow scales with speed, head with speed squared and power with density times speed cubed, for fixed geometry and comparable operating conditions.

corrections.before: CO$_2$ emissions per unit of production (kg CO$_2$/boe)
corrections.after: Emissions divided by a declared production or energy measure, with system boundary, gas coverage and CO2-equivalent convention stated.

corrections.before: Mathematical model (Arps) describing production rate decrease over time
corrections.after: Empirical production-rate trend, such as an Arps model; fitted coefficients and flow-regime applicability do not by themselves establish recoverable reserves.

corrections.before: Internal rate of return — discount rate at which NPV of a project equals zero
corrections.after: Discount rate at which project NPV is zero; cash-flow patterns can produce multiple IRRs or no economically useful root.

corrections.before: Statistical sampling method ensuring uniform coverage of parameter space
corrections.after: Stratified sampling that covers each marginal probability interval once; it does not guarantee uniform coverage of all joint combinations.

corrections.before: Probabilistic estimates at 10%, 50%, and 90% confidence levels
corrections.after: Quantile labels requiring an explicit convention. Under non-exceedance, P10 is the 10th percentile; petroleum resource exceedance notation commonly uses P10 for the high case and P90 for the low case.

corrections.before: Physics-Informed Neural Network — embeds governing equations (conservation laws) in the loss function to enforce physical consistency
corrections.after: Physics-informed neural network: includes equation residuals or physical constraints in training. Soft penalty terms encourage, but do not guarantee, conservation or an accurate solution.

corrections.before: NeqSim class for converging recycle streams in process simulations using successive substitution
corrections.after: NeqSim recycle-stream convergence equipment supporting direct substitution and optional acceleration; acceptance still requires residual and conservation checks.

corrections.before: Finding solutions that perform well across all uncertainty scenarios
corrections.after: Optimization imposing feasibility or performance requirements over a specified uncertainty set; coverage is limited to that set and the chosen formulation.

corrections.before: Direct facility emissions (Scope 1) vs. purchased electricity emissions (Scope 2)
corrections.after: Scope 1 covers direct emissions from owned or controlled sources; Scope 2 covers indirect emissions from purchased electricity, steam, heat and cooling.

corrections.before: Optimization under uncertainty using probability-weighted scenarios
corrections.after: Optimization using probability models for uncertain inputs, through sampling, probability-weighted scenarios or other stochastic formulations.

corrections.before: Bar chart ranking parameters by their impact on output uncertainty
corrections.after: Ranked one-at-a-time sensitivity ranges for a declared input variation and baseline; the bars are not generally a variance decomposition or probability distribution.

corrections.before: Uncertainty Quantification — methods for estimating and communicating prediction confidence (ensemble, Bayesian, conformal)
corrections.after: Uncertainty quantification: identifying, propagating and assessing uncertainties in inputs, observations, parameters and models with explicit assumptions and calibration evidence.

corrections.before: A measure of gas interchangeability — heating value divided by square root of specific gravity
corrections.after: Calorific value divided by the square root of gas relative density to air, using consistent reference conditions and gross/net basis; this is an interchangeability indicator, not a complete burner-compatibility test.
